cause.cause: Creates GPU shaders or draw handlers while registering, which cannot run in a headless Blender. It may well work with a display; this test cannot tell.
cause.fix: Create shaders and draw handlers lazily (first draw or first operator call) and skip them when bpy.app.background is True; that also makes the add-on testable in CI.
